coverage.name: Central Ho Chi Minh City (demo window)

datasets.notes: Normalized flat schema restricted to country = 'VN': id, name (names.primary), subtype, admin_level, class, region, division_id, is_land, source_dataset (sources[1].dataset), version, geometry, bbox. Overture holds provinces (region), wards and communes (locality), microhoods and neighborhoods here; there is NO district tier and none is inferred. Land and territorial-water versions of one unit are separate rows (is_land). Dropped: other names, other source records and every other raw column. Public demo subset: only the window [106.66, 10.74, 106.74, 10.81] (OGC:CRS84), rewritten with small row groups for browser range requests. A derived Overture database under the ODbL (share-alike); attribution as above.
